title: Keep NetworkManager-wait-online enabled
objective: The Arch performance fixers stop disabling NetworkManager-wait-online, so network-online.target waits for the LAN and the boot units ordered after it (reflector, periodic maintenance, nftables-drift) stop failing.
acceptance_criteria: fix_nm_wait_online and tweak_nm_wait_online enable the unit when disabled and never disable it
After a boot, systemctl --failed lists none of reflector, periodic-system-*, nftables-drift
verifier: bash linux_configuration/fixes/lib/tests/test_arch_perf_fixes.sh; bash linux_configuration/fixes/lib/tests/test_arch_hardware_boot.sh; systemctl --failed after the next boot
